name: Blairgowrie Surf Beach
signature: A consistent, sheltered ocean beach west of Rye — a quieter alternative with a friendly surf club and good beginners' conditions
editorNote:
Blairgowrie Surf Beach sits between Sorrento Back Beach and Rye Ocean Beach on the ocean side of the Peninsula and gets less traffic than either. The swell is slightly more sheltered than Rye — it wraps around the Sorrento headland — which makes it more forgiving for beginners and longboarders when the rest of the coast is too big.

Blairgowrie SLSC patrols through summer and runs a well-regarded Nippers program on Sunday mornings. The club has a strong family culture and tends to have shorter queues for Nippers registration than the bigger clubs at Rye or Rosebud.

Good for: first-time ocean swimmers, families with older kids who want more challenge than the bay, longboarders on smaller days.
whyWeGo: The Peninsula's most forgiving ocean beach — sheltered enough for beginners, consistent enough for regulars.
ifOnlyOneThing: Go on a small south swell day — 1.5-2ft is the sweet spot for most people.
